---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest an idea for LCode
title: "[Feature] "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''

---

## Problem Description

A clear and concise description of the problem or limitation you are facing.
What is the use case? What are you trying to achieve?

## Proposed Solution

A clear and concise description of what you want to happen, including how it
should work and, if possible, how it fits into the existing architecture.

## Alternatives Considered

A clear and concise description of any alternative solutions or workarounds
you have considered, and why they are not sufficient.

## Impact

- **Scope**: Which part of the project is affected? [e.g. agent core, tools, REPL, config]
- **Users**: Who benefits from this feature?
- **Effort estimate** (optional): Rough idea of implementation complexity, if known.

## Additional Context

Any other context, examples, or mockups that help illustrate the request.
